evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.MCL: Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Bowing of the medial meniscus secondary to adjacent medial meniscal pathology. Otherwise intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Complex degenerative tearing involving the anterior horn, body and posterior horn medial meniscus
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Degenerative signal posterior horn and posterior root with suspected degenerative tearing at the posterior horn-posterior root junction.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse full-thickness cartilage loss about the weightbearing medial femoral condyle
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss/fraying about the central weightbearing lateral femoral condyle.
evidence.PF OA: Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal partial thickness chondrosis central femoral trochlea.
evidence.Synovitis: Moderate complex multilobulated Baker's cyst with calcified bodies and synovial proliferation.
evidence.Baker's: Moderate complex multilobulated Baker's cyst with calcified bodies
evidence.Contusion: Osseous contusion involving the anterior peripheral aspect of the medial femoral condyle.
